name: The Golden Pot and Pints
review:
The Golden Pot and Pints is a 7x7 Irish pub cluster slot with avalanches and wilds. In the bonus, a persistent global multiplier keeps building.

Thunderkick rates it High volatility, with a 10,000x cap. The published RTP is 94.08%.

Avalanches chain wins on the 7x7 board, and in the bonus the global multiplier persists, so long rounds can grow considerably.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
